name: GitHub
description: Your GitHub work in lanes: pull requests waiting for your review, what happens on your own PRs, issues assigned to or mentioning you, and your failed CI runs, with unread marks and Discuss with Claude. Signs in with your gh CLI login (no token stored). Writes only to re-run failed jobs and to mark GitHub notifications read or done. Provides an inbox-feed for Inbox.
author: Oleg Bronzov

lanes.title: Lanes
lanes.description: Which lanes to show. A hidden lane is not fetched and its items never reach Inbox.

rowsPerLane.title: Items per lane
rowsPerLane.description: How many items a lane shows; the rest are behind Show all at the bottom of the lane.

markReadOnOpen.title: Mark an item read when I open it
markReadOnOpen.description: On: opening an item (here or from Inbox) marks it read. Off: it stays unread until you press Mark read.

exclude.title: Leave out
exclude.description: Owners (acme) or repositories (acme/widgets) whose items are not shown, any letter case.

pollMinutes.title: Check every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: Pull requests and issues; failed runs are checked every 5 minutes at most. Only while this project's window is open.

ghPath.title: gh program
ghPath.description: The GitHub CLI used to get your login's token: a name looked up on your login shell's PATH (gh) or an absolute path.
